what: the corpus lane's map of the readings that point to another entry, kept here byte for byte in the folders the lane keeps it in: each reading classed, and for a pointer the entry it names and that entry's first English in the source's own order. One entry per relay: the first sends the map whole, each later one sends the lines it changes, each carrying `line`, its number in the map; tools/pointer-map-v1.mjs lays them together, and tools/bake-form-of-pills-v1.mjs folds the map so made, under the owner's rulings, into the map the card reads (data/form-of-pills-v1.json)

assembled.what: the map as the relays lay it, map v1.4: each changed line, its `line` taken off, in place of the line it names, every line one JSON value, newline-terminated

note: every sha256 of a relay's file here is the one the relay's letter names for it, and the bytes taken hash to it. The map of v175 replaces the one of relay v101 (form-of/zone-pills-v1.2.jsonl), which was read from outside this tree; each line keeps what that map resolved beside the new resolution, as resolved_in_v1_2. The lines of v191 keep v1.3's resolution beside theirs where it changes (resolved_in_v1_3, in_v1_3). The owner's rulings 5 and 7 (data/rulings/) name the map of v175 by its sha256, and v191's rule keeps v1.3 standing in every part it does not name, so they are read by that sha256
